idle:

Use the attached female fox swordswoman image only as a reference for brushwork, crisp clean rendering and camera, NOT her identity. Create a NEW ordinary human young male traveler Tân: short tousled chestnut hair, friendly neutral face, brown eyes, humble brown wool tunic over cream long-sleeve shirt, moss green short scarf, plain belt, brown trousers and worn leather boots. Small plain wooden practice sword held low in his right hand, no metal blade. No armor, no elemental powers, no glow, no fox ears or tail, no crown.
Exact 2 columns by 2 rows grid, four equal square cells, square 1024x1024 sheet. In every cell full-body 3/4 facing right, same head/body proportions and outfit. Character's standing height exactly about 330 pixels within each 512 square cell, head top about y90, soles on y420. Centerline at x256. Keep entire subject including sword within central 68% of each cell. Four sequential subtle idle breathing poses: neutral; breathe in shoulders rise slightly; relaxed breath out with tiny scarf motion; return to neutral. Feet remain planted and no whole-body lateral motion. Consistent anatomical scale and camera, never zoom per pose. Background 100% solid flat #FF00FF magenta; no gradient, shadows, floor, text, labels, borders, guides or grid lines. No body part, hair, sword or fabric may cross cell edges. Exactly four sprites only, generous magenta padding on all sides.
